macros.name: AuthorTitleDelim
macros.doc: Delimiters \AuthorTitleDelim{⟨delimiter⟩} sets the delimiter between authors and titles in the body text when the nobibengine option is set to true.

macros.name: icite
macros.doc: icite provides the \icite command which both inserts a formatted citation in the body text and an entry corresponding to the passage cited in the index.

macros.name: SetTitleStyle
macros.doc: By default, titles are printed in italics. This can be changed in the preamble by \SetTitleStyle.

macros.name: TitlePageDelim
macros.doc: \TitlePageDelim{⟨delimiter⟩} sets the delimiter between titles and pages in the body text when the nobibengine option is set to true.
